# zinn_regions (Data Source)

The hosting regions a site can be placed in. Public: no API key needed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zinn_regions" "all" {}

output "region_slugs" {
  value = [for r in data.zinn_regions.all.regions : r.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String) City the region is in.
- `country` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `slug` (String) Region identifier, used as `region` when creating a site.
